svg.title: Browser TTS campaign metrics
svg.desc: 6 separate panels show Warm generation median, First PCM median, Real-time factor median, Warm output audio duration median, Mean Chrome RSS during generation, Pinned model weights. CPU and WebGPU bars appear when measured; unsupported and missing evidence are labeled. Scenarios are not pooled and this chart does not rate speech quality.
